text:
Maya: Heads up — seeing KV-cache drift leading to missing aggregates for two 1-hour windows in eu-west (approx 03:00-05:00 UTC). Console shows gaps in hourly_agg, looks like recompute never claimed the shards.
jon: ugh. Any logs from the backfill coordinator?
Maya: Not yet, but console trace shows a `claim_shard` timeout around 03:05. Might be quota exhaustion on the replay service.
Priya: Which quota? replay-worker slots or console token?
Maya: Replay-worker slot limit. The tenant hit reserved slots for Dedicated and got deprioritized -> claim retries failed.
Samir: Can we run a targeted backfill for those two windows only? Prefer not to kick a full-day recompute.
Maya: Agreed. I can trigger a targeted replay for shards a,b,c but need operator help to bump priority or temporarily increase slot quota.
jon: If it's priority routing we can set `--priority=high` on the operator command, but that bypasses fair-share. Ops ok with it if isolated.
Priya: ops ok with targeted high-priority for up to 30m. Please include replay job id in the ticket.
Maya: I'll kick it once Samir confirms shard list. Also patching console to surface claim failure reason (timeout vs quota) would help.
Nora: Filing a small UX ticket to add `claim_reason` to the backfill row in console (will show `timeout|quota|conflict`). PR incoming.
Maya: Shard list: s-113, s-114, s-115. Command I'm planning:
```
/replay start --shards s-113,s-114,s-115 --from 2026-03-07T03:00Z --to 2026-03-07T05:00Z --priority high
```
jon: Add `--dry-run` first to confirm plan. Then flip. Also tag in the ticket: `recompute:kv-drift`.
replay-bot: started replay job 7684 (initiated by Maya) — status: queued -> claimed by worker-09
Samir: Confirmed workers picked up job 7684 and progress shows ~10% after 3 minutes.
Maya: Nice. I'll watch and if claim errors reappear we should consider temporarily increasing `replay_slot_limit` for eu-west by 20%.
Priya: If slot bump needed, I can do a 30m override. Call it out in #eng-oncall if it happens.
Nora: UX PR is ready: adds `claim_reason` + a small tooltip explaining routing tiers and quota precedence. Link: https://console.redwood/dev/pr/1423
Maya: Thanks — closing loop: I'll update the ticket with job 7684 logs once complete. Will also add a follow-up RFC to make targeted backfills auto-escalate when consecutive claim_timeouts > 3. :thumbsup:
jon: SGTM.
